description: Java class SecurityConfig extends WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter to configure Spring Security settings, specifically permitting access to the root and H2 console, and disabling CSRF and frame options to allow H2 Console access.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Spring Security configuration class that permits access to root URL and H2 console, and disables CSRF and HTML frame restrictions.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter's method to customize HTTP security, permits all access to '/' and '/h2-console/**', disables CSRF, and disables frame options.
